summary: Tested voice recording feature integration for Income & Expense Tracker. All 7 backend API tests and all 10+ frontend tests passed. Voice endpoint is correctly wired, validates audio size, SA/US category switching works perfectly, and the VoiceTransactionRecorder component renders with all required UI elements.

critical_code_review_comments: INFO: The jurisdiction localStorage key must be uppercase 'US'/'ZA' (not lowercase). JurisdictionContext.jsx line 52-53: localStorage.getItem('jurisdiction') checked against jurisdictions[saved] keys which are 'ZA','US','CA','UK','AU'. This is working correctly as designed.
INFO: Subscription API returns 'free' tier for test account, but admin bypass (user.is_admin=true) in SubscriptionContext.jsx line 98 allows full access to all calculators. This works correctly.

MINOR: VoiceTransactionRecorder.jsx uses `new AudioContext()` without prefixes. Modern browsers support this, but the deprecated `webkitAudioContext` fallback is absent. Not a bug for current browsers.
